thumb_script_scope: Known 40mm schedule+offline geometric trajectory and joint preload, not constant force or live state feedback

failure_onsets_scope: Evaluation only: first stability/height breach, and first10 consecutive30Hz samples without thumb-slider contact. Legacy first_failure lists failed conditions by priority, not chronological onset. No control or completion-gate change.

pair_pressure.sample_scope: Every actualphysicalstep, arithmeticmean/min/max over8substeps at240Hz; Newtonlambda not dividedbydt; onlynormalcontribution. No forcefeedback to control.
